# First Pick — Hunter seller education

> Educational pages for Hunter NSW sellers covering Newcastle, Lake Macquarie, Maitland, Cessnock and Port Stephens.

- Education site: https://damienmueller-cloud.github.io/first-pick-hunter-edu/
- Matcher app: https://firstpickage-7wvpzzoe.manus.space
- Brand: First Pick / FirstPick Agent (seller → agent matching education)
